title: Compiled requirements versus the existing approach for the Causa write-path rehearsal
tests_hypotheses: H1: With scope and acceptance held constant, executing from the compiled package (Plan A or B) reaches the same or more verified requirements with fewer integration failures than deriving from the baseline at kickoff.
H2: Plan B uses fewer tokens, tool calls and CI runs than Plan A at the same verified coverage.
H3: Plan A reaches the first verified remote write sooner than Plan B.
launch: NOT LAUNCHED. This mission defines the experiment only; no rehearsal is run.
preconditions: Every readiness blocker in requirements-validation-report.json is resolved; otherwise an arm measures blocker handling, not execution
The kickoff release set lock exists (T03) and is identical for every arm
The baseline is pinned at one indy-init commit, identical for every arm, and the package is recompiled against it

arms.name: existing approach
arms.treatment: Agent starts from kickoff/indy-init.kickoff.json and the R4 plan, derives requirements itself (RDP procedure); the compiled package is withheld.

arms.name: compiled + time optimized
arms.treatment: Agent receives this package and executes Plan A (parallel lanes; needs the owner approval in F-007).

arms.name: compiled + resource optimized
arms.treatment: Agent receives this package and executes Plan B (one lead agent, fresh reviewer, batched CI).

heldConstant: application scope: the pinned baseline plus the owner's T00 decisions
acceptance: verification-manifest.json entries and the computed verdict
model identifier and model settings (recorded per run; a model change during a run invalidates the run)
runner image, CI workflow definitions and the test data repository state at start (fresh workspace path per run)

design.unit: one timed run from first green bootstrap CI (R4 P5) to the computed verdict or 420 minutes
design.replication: at least two runs per arm; order of arms randomised; all runs within one release-set lock
design.minimumViable: If full runs are unaffordable, run the bounded write-path slice (T12 to T21) per arm with the same metrics; report it as a slice result, never as a full-rehearsal result
confounders: model or provider version change between runs
dependency drift (new upstream releases): blocked by the run lock
GitHub API rate limits and runner queue time: recorded as time.waiting_ms and CI queue seconds and reported separately
learning effects: each run starts from an empty repository and a fresh agent context
design.analysis: Report per-arm medians and ranges, never a single-run difference as an effect. No efficiency claim without at least two runs per arm showing the same direction; otherwise 'inconclusive'.

metrics.name: Total tokens
metrics.source: Praxis >= 3.17 attribution per agent (R4 section 5) mapped to Percepta telemetry

metrics.name: Elapsed time to computed verdict and to each R4 milestone
CI executions created, executed, failed
metrics.source: GitHub Actions API for the rehearsal repository (no Percepta metric defines CI runs; tool.build_executions is local builds only)

metrics.name: Integration failures
metrics.source: failed integration checkpoints (T17, T21, T31) plus defects found after first green CI, classified by defect class

metrics.name: Fix-induced defects
metrics.source: defect records citing a fix SHA as cause

metrics.name: Requirement coverage
metrics.source: ledger rows PASS with evidence over baseline requirements; preservation gate verdict

metrics.name: Verified completion
metrics.source: compute-acceptance-verdict.py verdict and Dokimos completion verify receipts

metrics.name: Evidence freshness failures
metrics.source: Dokimos EVIDENCE_STALE / FRESHNESS_UNDETERMINED / VALIDATION_UNBOUND refusals and compute-acceptance-verdict evidence-at-SHA failures

metrics.name: Requirements silently omitted
metrics.source: preservation gate disposition-missing and obligation-unmapped findings

successCriteria: None pre-declared as an improvement. Each hypothesis is reported supported, contradicted or inconclusive from the measured values.
